title: Last Stand at the Ember Caldera

concept.title: Last Stand at the Ember Caldera
concept.logline: On ash-choked, tense Essmaw, you hold on long enough to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ash Beacon.
concept.source_prompt: Ember Caldera. volcano volcanic lava caldera survival Last stand
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Basalt Refuge and becomes the one who brings the Ash Beacon back to life.

key_locations.name: Basalt Refuge
key_locations.description: The start: Basalt Refuge, where every trail of the outpost cluster begins.

key_locations.description: Miners' Camp: a camp on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

characters.name: Forgemaster Isla
characters.description: Waits in Basalt Refuge and knows why the Ash Beacon fell silent.

characters.name: Hale the Apprentice
characters.description: Follows you from Basalt Refuge and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Cinder Hound
characters.description: A cinder hound that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Magma Sentinel
characters.description: A magma sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Tobin the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Essmaw for anything shiny.

characters.name: Ash Beetle
characters.description: A harmless ash beetle that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Hold out until the storm breaks
hazards: Ash sweeping the exposed ground around the Ash Beacon
Lava vents that scorch anyone who lingers
Cinder Hound hunting near its lair
Magma Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

Check the landmark in Basalt Refuge

actions.value: On ash-choked, tense Essmaw, you hold on long enough to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ash Beacon.
Reach the Ash Beacon, light it, and hold out for 40 seconds.
The storm is here. Hold for 40 seconds!
The storm breaks. The Ash Beacon held.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: So you've come to Basalt Refuge at last. I am Forgemaster Isla. On ash-choked, tense Essmaw, you hold on long enough to recover the cooling gems and restore the Ash Beacon.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: Back again. Basalt Refuge is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: Go to Miners' Camp, then Lava Quay. Whatever still remembers Last Stand at the Ember Caldera is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Basalt Refuge, Last Stand at the Ember Caldera was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Ominous, even then.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: Miners' Camp: Miners' Camp: a camp on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Last Stand at the Ember Caldera back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Forgemaster Isla
nodes.text: Lava Quay: Lava Quay: a dock on the way out from Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Apprentice
nodes.text: Hale the Apprentice circles your feet, then looks toward Ash Beacon as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Apprentice
nodes.text: Hale the Apprentice keeps close and glances back at Basalt Refuge.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Apprentice
nodes.text: It turns toward Ash Beacon. Ash Beacon: the far end of the outpost cluster, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Cinder Hound
nodes.text: The cinder hound watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Basalt Refuge. Tobin the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Last Stand at the Ember Caldera that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Miners' Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Ash Beetle
nodes.text: The ash beetle freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
